verses.en: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded:
verses.pt: Então veio o Espírito de Deus sobre Azarias, filho de Odede,
verses.en_web: The Spirit of God came on Azariah the son of Oded:
verses.en_bbe: And the spirit of God came on Azariah, the son of Oded;

verses.en: And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The LORD is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.
verses.pt: que saiu ao encontro de Asa e lhe disse: Ouvi-me, Asa, e todo o Judá e Benjamim: O Senhor está convosco, enquanto vós estais com ele; se o buscardes, o achareis; mas se o deixardes, ele vos deixará.
verses.en_web: and he went out to meet Asa, and said to him, “Hear me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin! Yahweh is with you, while you are with him; and if you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will forsake you.
verses.en_bbe: And he came face to face with Asa and said to him, Give ear to me, Asa and all Judah and Benjamin: the Lord is with you while you are with him; if your heart's desire is for him, he will be near you, but if you give him up, he will give you up.

verses.en: Now for a long season Israel hath been without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law.
verses.pt: Ora, por muito tempo Israel esteve sem o verdadeiro Deus, sem sacerdote que o ensinasse e sem lei.
verses.en_web: Now for a long time Israel was without the true God, without a teaching priest, and without law.
verses.en_bbe: Now for a long time Israel has been without the true God, and without a teaching priest and without the law;

verses.en: But when they in their trouble did turn unto the LORD God of Israel, and sought him, he was found of them.
verses.pt: Quando, porém, na sua angústia voltaram para o Senhor, Deus de Israel, e o buscaram, o acharam.
verses.en_web: But when in their distress they turned to Yahweh, the God of Israel, and sought him, he was found by them.
verses.en_bbe: But when in their trouble they were turned to the Lord, the God of Israel, searching after him, he let their search be rewarded.

verses.en: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries.
verses.pt: E naqueles tempos não havia paz nem para o que saia, nem para o que entrava, mas grandes perturbações estavam sobre todos os habitantes daquelas terras.
verses.en_web: In those times there was no peace to him who went out, nor to him who came in; but great troubles were on all the inhabitants of the lands.
verses.en_bbe: In those times there was no peace for him who went out or for him who came in, but great trouble was on all the people of the lands.

verses.en: And nation was destroyed of nation, and city of city: for God did vex them with all adversity.
verses.pt: Pois nação contra nação e cidade contra cidade se despedaçavam, porque Deus as conturbara com toda sorte de aflições.
verses.en_web: They were broken in pieces, nation against nation, and city against city; for God troubled them with all adversity.
verses.en_bbe: And they were broken by divisions, nation against nation and town against town, because God sent all sorts of trouble on them.

verses.en: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.
verses.pt: Vós, porém, esforçai-vos, e não desfaleçam as vossas mãos; porque a vossa obra terá uma recompensa.
verses.en_web: But you be strong, and don’t let your hands be slack; for your work will be rewarded.”
verses.en_bbe: But be you strong and let not your hands be feeble, for your work will be rewarded.

verses.en: And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim, and renewed the altar of the LORD, that was before the porch of the LORD.
verses.pt: Asa, tendo ouvido estas palavras, e a profecia do profeta filho de Odede, cobrou ânimo e lançou fora as abominações de toda a terra de Judá e de Benjamim, como também das cidades que tomara na região montanhosa de Efraim, e renovou o altar do Senhor, que estava diante do pórtico do Senhor.
verses.en_web: When Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominations out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from the hill country of Ephraim; and he renewed Yahweh’s altar that was before Yahweh’s porch.
verses.en_bbe: And Asa, hearing these words of Azariah, the son of Oded the prophet, took heart and put away all the disgusting things out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the towns which he had taken from the hill-country of Ephraim; and he made new again the altar of the Lord in front of the covered way of the Lord's house.

verses.en: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance, when they saw that the LORD his God was with him.
verses.pt: E congregou todo o Judá e Benjamim, e os de Efraim, Manassés e Simeão que com eles peregrinavam; pois que muitos e Israel tinham vindo a ele quando viram que o Senhor seu Deus era com ele.
verses.en_web: He gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and those who lived with them out of Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon; for they came to him out of Israel in abundance when they saw that Yahweh his God was with him.
verses.en_bbe: And he got together all Judah and Benjamin and those of Ephraim and Manasseh and Simeon who were living with them; for numbers of them came to him out of Israel when they saw that the Lord his God was with him.

verses.en: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.
verses.pt: Ajuntaram-se em Jerusalém no terceiro mês, no décimo quinto ano do reinado de Asa.
verses.en_web: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of Asa’s reign.
verses.en_bbe: So they came together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the rule of Asa.

verses.en: And they offered unto the LORD the same time, of the spoil which they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.
verses.pt: E no mesmo dia ofereceram em sacrifício ao Senhor, do despojo que trouxeram, setecentos bois e sete mil ovelhas.
verses.en_web: They sacrificed to Yahweh in that day, of the plunder which they had brought, seven hundred head of cattle and seven thousand sheep.
verses.en_bbe: And that day they made offerings to the Lord of the things they had taken in war, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.

verses.en: And they entered into a covenant to seek the LORD God of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul;
verses.pt: E entraram no pacto de buscarem ao Senhor, Deus de seus pais, de todo o seu coração e de toda a sua alma;
verses.en_web: They entered into the covenant to seek Yahweh, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and with all their soul;
verses.en_bbe: And they made an agreement to be true to the Lord, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and all their soul;

verses.en: That whosoever would not seek the LORD God of Israel should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
verses.pt: e de que todo aquele que não buscasse ao Senhor, Deus de Israel, fosse morto, tanto pequeno como grande, tanto homem como mulher.
verses.en_web: and that whoever would not seek Yahweh, the God of Israel, should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
verses.en_bbe: And that anyone, small or great, man or woman, who was not true to the Lord, the God of Israel, would be put to death.

verses.en: And they sware unto the LORD with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.
verses.pt: E prestaram juramento ao Senhor em alta voz, com júbilo, ao som de trombetas e buzinas.
verses.en_web: They swore to Yahweh with a loud voice, with shouting, with trumpets, and with cornets.
verses.en_bbe: And they made an oath to the Lord, with a loud voice, sounding wind-instruments and horns.

verses.en: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath: for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and the LORD gave them rest round about.
verses.pt: E todo o Judá se alegrou deste juramento; porque de todo o seu coração juraram, e de toda a sua vontade buscaram ao Senhor, e o acharam; e o Senhor lhes deu descanso ao redor.
verses.en_web: All Judah rejoiced at the oath, for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found by them. Then Yahweh gave them rest all around.
verses.en_bbe: And all Judah was glad because of the oath, for they had taken it with all their heart, turning to the Lord with all their desire; and he was with them and gave them rest on every side.

verses.en: And also concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king, he removed her from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove: and Asa cut down her idol, and stamped it, and burnt it at the brook Kidron.
verses.pt: O rei Asa depôs Maacá, sua mãe, para que não fosse mais rainha, porquanto ela fizera um abominável ídolo para servir de Asera, ao qual Asa derrubou e, despedaçando-o, o queimou junto ao ribeiro de Cedrom.
verses.en_web: Also Maacah, the mother of Asa the king, he removed from being queen, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah; so Asa cut down her image, ground it into dust, and burned it at the brook Kidron.
verses.en_bbe: And Asa would not let Maacah, his mother, be queen, because she had made a disgusting image for Asherah; and Asa had her image cut down and broken up and burned by the stream Kidron.

verses.en: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
verses.pt: Os altos, porém, não se tiraram de Israel; contudo o coração de Asa foi perfeito todos os seus dias.
verses.en_web: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel; nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
verses.en_bbe: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel; but still the heart of Asa was true to the Lord all his life.

verses.en: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.
verses.pt: E trouxe para a casa de Deus as coisas que seu pai tinha consagrado, e as que ele mesmo tinha consagrado: prata, ouro e utensílios.
verses.en_web: He brought the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, gold, and vessels into God’s house.
verses.en_bbe: He took into the house of God all the things which his father had made holy and those which he himself had made holy, silver and gold and vessels.

verses.en: And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.
verses.pt: E não mais houve guerra até o ano trigésimo quinto do reinado de Asa.
verses.en_web: There was no more war to the thirty-fifth year of Asa’s reign.
verses.en_bbe: And there was no more war till the thirty-fifth year of the rule of Asa.
